tergal.definition: a. Of or pertaining to back, or tergum. See Dorsal.
tergal.translation:
a. 背的, 背甲的
[医] 背的, 背面的

tergals.definition:
plural of tergal
a. Of or pertaining to back, or tergum. See Dorsal.
tergals.translation:
(tergal 的复数) a. 背的, 背甲的
[医] 背的, 背面的

tergant.definition: a. Showing the back; as, the eagle tergant.
tergant.translation: a. 显示出背部的, 作拱背状的

tergeminate.definition: a. Thrice twin; having three pairs of leaflets.

tergiant.translation: a. 显示出背部的, 作拱背状的

tergiferous.definition: a. Carrying or bearing upon the back.

tergite.definition:
n. The dorsal portion of an arthromere or somite of an
   articulate animal. See Illust. under Coleoptera.

tergites.definition:
plural of tergite
n. The dorsal portion of an arthromere or somite of an
   articulate animal. See Illust. under Coleoptera.

tergiversate.definition:
v be deliberately ambiguous or unclear in order to mislead or withhold information
v abandon one's beliefs or allegiances
tergiversate.translation: vi. 搪塞, 推托, 变节, 背叛

v be deliberately ambiguous or unclear in order to mislead or withhold information

tergiversates.definition:
v be deliberately ambiguous or unclear in order to mislead or withhold information

tergiversating.definition:
v be deliberately ambiguous or unclear in order to mislead or withhold information

tergiversation.definition:
n falsification by means of vague or ambiguous language
n the act of abandoning a party for cause
tergiversation.translation: n. 搪塞, 背叛, 变节

tergiversations.definition:

tergiversator.definition:
n. One who tergiversates; one who suffles, or practices
   evasion.

tergum.definition:
n. The back of an animal.
n. The dorsal piece of a somite of an articulate animal.
n. One of the dorsal plates of the operculum of a cirriped.
tergum.translation:
n. 背板
[医] 背, 背板(昆虫)
